core: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in branching organ development
name: Epithelial-mesenchymal signaling in lung and branching organ development
rationale: Members are epithelial-mesenchymal interactions driving bud growth and branching, dominated by lung, trachea and pneumocyte development plus salivary, palate and limb buds; confusables center on pancreas, kidney or prostate instead.

name: Monocyte recruitment and endothelial adhesion control in inflammation
rationale: All members concern monocyte/macrophage chemotaxis, extravasation, activation and inflammatory cytokine output; unlike confusables the theme adds regulation of leukocyte adhesion to endothelium and adhesion-molecule production.

name: TrkB (NTRK2) neurotrophin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are BDNF/NTF3/NTF4 activation of NTRK2 and its downstream PLCG1, PI3K, RAS, RAC1 and CDK5 branches, distinguishing it from NTRK3 and TRKA/NGF themes and from postsynaptic plasticity.

qualifier: endoreduplicative trophoblast giant and decidual cells
name: Endoreduplicative trophoblast and decidual differentiation in pregnancy
rationale: Members are trophoblast giant cell differentiation, decidualization, endoreduplication and embryonic processes of pregnancy, unlike confusables on ovarian cycle, zygotic transition, germ cells or labyrinth placenta.

name: Nucleotide and inositol pyrophosphate phosphotransfer metabolism
rationale: Members interconvert nucleoside mono-, di- and triphosphates and metabolize pyrophosphate-containing inositol and diadenosine polyphosphates, unlike confusables on creatine/mitochondrial ADP transport, nuclear PIPs or deoxyribonucleotides.

name: RUNX1-regulated myeloid progenitor fate and megakaryocyte differentiation
rationale: Members regulate myeloid progenitor choices among granulocyte, monocyte, erythroid and megakaryocyte fates with RUNX1 and platelet modules, lacking the erythroid/HSC content of one confusable and adding RUNX1/megakaryocyte content absent from the granulopoiesis confusable.

qualifier: CFTR trafficking to the plasma membrane
name: CFTR trafficking and transepithelial anion-water transport
rationale: Members cover CFTR trafficking and defects, anion transport regulation, transepithelial water flow and Golgi-to-plasma-membrane/basolateral delivery, unlike apical-raft or secretion-regulation confusables.

name: Caspase-8-controlled death receptor apoptosis and necroptosis
rationale: Members are Fas/TRAIL/TLR3-TRIF death signaling through procaspase-8, c-FLIP and BID or RIPK1 necroptosis, distinguishing it from execution-phase, mitochondrial and T-cell apoptosis confusables.

qualifier: p53 phosphorylation and turnover after irradiation
name: G2 DNA damage checkpoint and p53 stabilization after irradiation
rationale: Members span G2/M checkpoint signaling (GTSE1), gamma-radiation response and p53 regulation by phosphorylation and degradation, unlike confusables centered on COP1, Cdc25A degradation or p53 transcriptional targets.

core: Transcriptional control of myeloid progenitor fate
name: Transcriptional control of granulocyte-monocyte progenitor fate
rationale: Members are myeloid progenitor proliferation, granulopoiesis transcription, VENTX and RA/WNT/CSF networks restraining granulocyte, monocyte and macrophage differentiation, lacking the RUNX1/megakaryocyte content of its closest confusable.

name: Fc gamma receptor phagocytosis via actin cup formation
rationale: All three members describe receptor-triggered phagocytosis with actin remodeling of the phagocytic cup, unlike confusables on inhibitory Fc signaling or generic lamellipodial actin.

name: Endocardial cushion EMT and cardiac valve morphogenesis
rationale: Members are endocardial differentiation, cushion epithelial-mesenchymal transition and fusion, and formation of all four valves, whereas confusables cover myocardium, septa and conduction.

name: Gonadotropin-regulated gonad, follicle and germ cell development
rationale: Members span GnRH/FSH/LH secretion and response, follicle growth, ovulation, luteinization, testis somatic cells and germ cell meiosis, unlike activin/AMH or oocyte-maturation confusables.

name: Amine catabolism and organic cation transport
rationale: Members degrade monoamines, choline and trimethylamine and carry organic cations including carnitine precursors, unlike confusables centered on catecholamine and serotonin biosynthesis.

name: Centrosome duplication, maturation and mitotic spindle orientation
rationale: Members regulate centriole duplication, mitotic centrosome maturation (AURKA, PLK1, NuMA) and spindle assembly and positioning, unlike confusables on cytokinesis/checkpoint, cilia or microtubule anchoring.

name: Enhanced glucose import and adiponectin secretion
rationale: Members promote cellular glucose import and regulate adiponectin secretion, unlike confusables on insulin receptor signaling, its negative regulation or GLUT4 translocation.

name: Urate metabolism and renal urate transport
rationale: All members concern urate metabolism and its SLC2A9/SLC22A12 renal transport defects, unlike sugar, drug-anion or cystine transport confusables.

name: Embryonic face and cranium morphogenesis
rationale: Members are neurocranium, viscerocranium, face, nose and anterior head development, unlike confusables on limbs, pharyngeal organs, palate or inner ear.

name: Pre-mRNA 3'-end cleavage, polyadenylation and histone mRNA processing
rationale: Members cover cleavage/polyadenylation, transcription termination and SLBP-dependent and independent histone pre-mRNA processing, unlike export, snRNA/splicing or mRNA decay confusables.

name: Golgi-derived vesicle traffic to endosomes and lysosomes
rationale: Members are Golgi vesicle biogenesis, Golgi-to-endosome/lysosome transport, endosomal fusion and protein secretion, unlike confusables on retrograde endosome-to-Golgi or intra-Golgi/COPI traffic.

name: Glucagon and nutrient-sensing GPCR signaling
rationale: Members are glucagon, free fatty acid, hydroxycarboxylic acid and somatostatin receptor signaling with adenylate cyclase and GH secretion control, unlike insulin-secretion or calcitonin/amylin confusables.

name: Xenobiotic and plant-compound detoxification with FMO oxidation
rationale: Members metabolize toxins, drugs and plant-derived terpenoids, alkaloids, phenylpropanoids and polyketides via oxidation, sulfonation and acetylation, with FMO pathways absent from all confusables.

name: T cell activation and CD8/gamma-delta lineage differentiation
rationale: Members are T cell signaling, costimulation and differentiation including CD8 alpha-beta and gamma-delta T cells, unlike proximal TCR, IL-2/IL-7 cytokine or thymocyte/B cell confusables.

name: Viral structural protein maturation and host pathway targeting
rationale: Members are maturation and assembly of coronavirus, RSV and dengue proteins plus SARS-CoV host signaling targeting, whereas confusables emphasize viral attachment, entry and release.

qualifier: commissural pathfinding with ephrin and L1
name: Commissural axon pathfinding and ephrin-L1 guidance signaling
rationale: Members combine netrin/DCC attraction and SLIT-ROBO commissural pathfinding with ephrin repulsion, L1 signaling and fasciculation, unlike confusables on netrin repulsion, axon extension or ROBO-Rho GTPase control.
